reviews.title: Good quality, Great price!
reviews.comment: Replacement lavalier microphones for Shure wireless systems have been available for a while now, but I'm glad that they're now available through Amazon.  They work fine, hold up acceptably well, and are MUCH less expensive that replacement lavaliers directly from Shure.
reviews.author: Stephen Sanborn

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.comment: I use these with Shure wireless transmitters at our church for the pastor and his associate.  hey perform well for speaking, and are far more economical than the brand name equivalent.  They are about as durable as the originals, but inexpensive enough that I keep two spares on hand for the day one dies unexpectedly.
reviews.author: March2007

reviews.title: Sound Quality was just OK.
reviews.comment: We needed a few mics in a hurry for our school musical.  These mics worked, but the sound quality was not on par with other mics.  But they were also much cheaper and did the job in a pinch.
reviews.author: j.rom

reviews.title: These work surprisingly well
reviews.comment: I run sound for a theater group that uses Shure ULX-D's with Countryman B3 lavs.  That's definitely not what you're buying here, but I bought these in a pinch because the director decided to give out more mic'd parts than we actually had mics for.  These really can't be compared to a Countryman - it's an $18 lav vs a $200 lav... But the audience would not have known the difference. I'm guessing we'll have to be extremely careful with these, but as opposed to other theater groups I work with, this group is extremely careful with all equipment, so I wouldn't be surprised if they last a while.
reviews.author: Christopher Cass

reviews.title: Great Budget Mic
reviews.comment: For a budget lavalier mic these can't be beat.  Good pickup and clarity with our Shure BLX1 transmitters.
reviews.author: sfrancisco896
